In the appendix to the final environmental statement, additional responses are provided by the Department to numerous comments contained in the letters of comment from the public. Many of the comments received were substantive and generally reflected the area of expertise of the reviewing agency, organization, or individual. They were most helpful in improving the final environmental statement.
Appended letters of comment without specific response from the Department are believed to be covered by the improved final environmental statement.
Appended Tables 1 and 2 provide detailed information on the 144 responses received concerning the draft environmental statement.
Table 1 has the responses listed by name, date and number pages, and whether from Federal, State, or local governmental agency, or private organization or individual. These responses have been filed by chronological date and given the numbers 1 through 116 and are filed in the Appendix to this statement. These numbers are stamped in the lower left hand corner of each page. Thus, the first response was received from the State of Wyoming, Executive Department, and was dated 6-12-72; it was given the number "1" and filed as the first page in these responses. The second response was from the American Motorcycle Association, and was dated 6-21-72; it was given the number "2" and filed after response number "1." Thus, the sequence for numbering and filing all responses. Response #91, dated 8-3-72, consists of the signatures of 29 Nevada residents, and adding these to the other 115 responses makes a total of 144 responses received.
Table 2 provides a breakdown of the responses by types of agencies and individuals, listing the names of ORV user groups, mining and geophysical exploration groups, conservation and environmental groups, colleges and universities, and private citizens.
